{"consolidated_memory":"DROPPED FRAMES IN realtime/ws/session.ts - TWO SEPARATE OCCASIONS

**Occasion 1: [2026-02-07] - Race condition in lazy initialization**
- File: realtime/ws/session.ts (realtime side)
- Problem: dropped frames in websocket session
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Repro: hold a socket open through a network flap
- Root cause: race in lazy initialisation
- Signal: frames missing from the client sequence
- Result: p99 latency fell from 5.4 s to 730 ms
- Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- PR #7680, branch fix/dropped-frames-1

**Occasion 2: [2026-06-03] - Listener leak on teardown**
- File: realtime/ws/session.ts (realtime side)
- Problem: dropped frames in websocket session
- Trigger: payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Repro: hold a socket open through a network flap
- Root cause: listener registered but never removed
- Signal: frames missing from the client sequence
- Result: reclaimed 9 GB of blob storage
- Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- PR #7980, branch fix/dropped-frames-2

Both issues occurred in the same corner of realtime/ws/session.ts; context and learnings carried forward between the two efforts."}
